task.title: Stabilize WebAR navigation with route-relative progress, calibrated heading, confidence-weighted steps, and state hysteresis. [tdd:required]
task.definition_of_done: Signed route progress makes forward/reverse distance deterministic; heading calibrates from stable samples to the active route and can be reset in AR; arrow turns responsively; turning steps are confidence-weighted; off-route state requires sustained enter/exit evidence; arrival uses stable route-relative distance and still clears after walking away.

checks.description: Signed route progress makes forward/reverse distance deterministic; heading calibrates from stable samples to the active route and can be reset in AR; arrow turns responsively; turning steps are confidence-weighted; off-route state requires sustained enter/exit evidence; arrival uses stable route-relative distance and still clears after walking away.
Verify route progress stays local to the active route, supports reverse and endpoint overshoot, and never teleports across path segments.
Verify heading calibration blocks steps until stable, and AR recalibration preserves route progress.
Verify off-route and arrival state transitions have independent hysteresis.

non_goals.description: Do not change floor geometry, Walk path authoring, QR Anchor data, or destination coordinates.

browser_validation.description: Signed route progress makes forward/reverse distance deterministic; heading calibrates from stable samples to the active route and can be reset in AR; arrow turns responsively; turning steps are confidence-weighted; off-route state requires sustained enter/exit evidence; arrival uses stable route-relative distance and still clears after walking away.

reviewer_notes: Real sensor accuracy still requires a physical phone walk; automated validation covers deterministic state transitions and production build compatibility.

Initial review found premature automatic heading calibration and insufficient rotation-only rejection. Explicit calibration gating, a 0.6 second stable hold, and cadence-plus-waveform evidence were added before the second review approved the change.
